With over a decade of experience in healthtech, I blend technical expertise with a passion for solving complex problems that drive meaningful impact. As a Senior Data Scientist at HealthInsight Analytics, I specialize in building scalable data pipelines and predictive models that transform raw data into actionable insights for healthcare innovation.  

My work spans designing REST APIs to integrate diverse health datasets, optimizing workflows with Apache Airflow, and leveraging Apache Spark for large-scale analytics. I’ve pioneered Bayesian approaches and time series analysis to enhance forecasting accuracy, while my focus on feature engineering ensures models are both robust and interpretable.  

MLOps is central to my practice—using MLflow and Weights & Biases to streamline model development, track experiments, and foster collaboration across teams. I’ve also led data warehousing initiatives that underpin our analytics infrastructure, ensuring reliability and scalability.  

Beyond technical execution, I enjoy mentoring colleagues and contributing to architectural decisions that shape our data strategy. My goal is to advance healthtech through intelligent, ethical solutions that bridge data science and real-world impact. Let’s connect if you’re tackling challenges where analytics meets humanity.
